timing_semantics.build: Host C/assembly compilation and linking; excludes inference
timing_semantics.process: Host elapsed time including QEMU launch, firmware boot, execution, logs and exit
timing_semantics.guest_ticks: QEMU8.2.2 SYS_ELAPSED uses host elapsed nanoseconds; includes emulation and boundary overhead, not target cycles
timing_semantics.demo: The vector loop is a synthetic infrastructure probe, not model inference

memory_semantics.stack: Painted stack written high-water estimate; reserved stack is the conservative capacity
memory_semantics.arena: Peak allocations through bench_alloc only; external allocators must be separately instrumented
memory_semantics.reserved_resident_ram: Linked ITCM code/data plus reserved arena and stack; QSPI assets reported separately; no OS/model acceptance implied
